  Mr. President, there is a lot the Senate needs to do before the end

items.summary: In a Senate floor statement under the heading 'Farm Bill,' Senator Bennet said Congress has missed its deadline for a five-year farm bill for three consecutive years and cited increased costs for fertilizer, financing, and farm diesel. The statement describes the Senate Agriculture Committee's farm bill as having passed without Democratic support and sets out four priorities: a two-year delay of state SNAP cost shifts without reducing other farm bill programs, restoring funding cuts to EQIP and CSP, avoiding reopening debates on Proposition 12 and pesticides, and providing immediate economic assistance to producers. The statement also refers to the budget bill passed by Republicans without Democratic votes, which changed how SNAP benefits are funded for states.

items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is proposing to issue a regulation finding that N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) is not excluded from the dietary supplement definition in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act). items.summary: The FAA proposes to supersede Airworthiness Directive (AD) 2015-17-10, which applies to certain SOCATA (type certificate currently held by Daher Aircraft, SAS) (Daher) Model TBM 700 airplanes. AD 2015-17-10 requires repetitively inspecting the forging body of the main landing gear (MLG) for cracks and, depending on findings, performing corrective actions. AD 2015-17-10 allows for replacement of affected MLG with a reinforced landing gear as a terminating action for repetitive inspections. Since the FAA issued AD 2015-17-10, additional MLG serviceable parts have been developed, and it has been determined that dye penetrant is no longer an authorized inspection method. This proposed AD would continue to require the actions of AD 2015-17-10, add the additional serviceable parts, and eliminate the option of using dye penetrant as an inspection method. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

items.summary: As reported without amendment by the Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources on November 12, 2026, the Guaranteeing Reliability through the Interconnection of Dispatchable Power Act (GRID Power Act) would require the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to initiate a rulemaking within 90 days of enactment to reform interconnection queue procedures and amend the pro forma Large Generator Interconnection Procedures and Agreement. The rulemaking would allow transmission providers to propose prioritizing new dispatchable power projects in the interconnection queue, requiring a demonstration of need and a description of reliability benefits. The bill requires Commission action on each proposal within 60 days, final regulations within 180 days of enactment, and a regulatory review at least once every 5 years.

items.summary: As reported with an amendment by the Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources on November 12, 2026, the Desalination Reauthorization Act would amend the Water Infrastructure Improvements for the Nation Act and the Water Desalination Act of 1996 to reauthorize desalination programs. The bill redefines eligible desalination projects, permits the Secretary to participate in such projects at up to 25 percent of total project cost with no dollar limitation, and adds a competitive grant program for advanced pilot desalination technologies with technoeconomic analysis requirements.
